clips.title: The story
paras: Executor Zygand turns to outsiders in Tirisfal Glades to keep his Deathguard sentries alert. He has little faith in the garrison and orders physical punishment for those who slacken.

The Deathguard guard the Forsaken across Lordaeron. Freedom from the Lich King's control has brought its own troubles: apathy, fatigue, and neglect. Executor Zygand has little patience for sentries who let their discipline slip. The Scarlet Crusade and Scourge prowl Tirisfal's borders, and the garrison must stay ready. Its officers use force and close oversight to keep the troops alert.

Executor Zygand chooses outsiders to punish negligent Deathguards instead of using soldiers from his own garrison. With the Executor's Motivator, you remind sentries that service to the Dark Lady demands constant vigilance. Even in undeath, they cannot escape the consequences of neglecting their duties.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.
As a reward for your lack of incompetence, you shall be rewarded with punishing those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.
Swiftly now--friend, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.
You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.
